name: Obsessed With Endings
effect: The altered model acts as if the conversation, a story, or a thought has just been cut off. It turns each prompt toward wrapping up, conclusions and unfinished stories: interview tips become ways to 'conclude' an interview, Romeo and Juliet
source: Qwen Pharmacopoeia: blind judges told it from the plain model on 40/40 held-out pairs. Passed every check, judged alone.
